download_convert_hf_to_gguf: download the convert_hf_to_gguf.py dependency file from the llama.cpp GitHub repository
wrap_model_instance_for_gguf: wrap a model instance with layer config and tensor functions for GGUF export
prepare_tensors_for_gguf_writer: prepare and quantize model tensors, then add them to the GGUF writer with proper data types
quant_data_with_auto_round_config: quantize a torch tensor using scale, zero point, and imatrix from the AutoRound module config
map_layer_config_to_ggml_qtype: map an AutoRound layer config entry to the corresponding GGML quantization type by bit width
